title: Terms of Employment (Information) Act 1994 ss. 3, 3A, 4 and 6D: the statement of terms of employment
source: Terms of Employment (Information) Act 1994 ss. 3, 3A, 4 and 6D as amended by the Employment (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 2018 and S.I. No. 686 of 2022 (in force 16 December 2022); Protection of Employees (Fixed-Term Work) Act 2003 s. 9A. Read 2026-10-09.
note: A drafting check, not legal advice: the scripted rules read whether a particular is there, never whether a term is lawful.

rules.text: The core terms within five days of the start, the full statement within one month.

The core terms: both full names, the employer's address, a temporary or fixed term's length or end, the pay with its pay reference period, the hours expected per normal day and per normal week, the place, the job, the start, the hours and overtime terms, the probation.

The rest: pay intervals, paid leave, sick pay, pensions, notice, collective agreements with any registered employment agreement or employment regulation order and where to get a copy, training, agency users, social insurance, and that the employee may ask for their average hourly rate.
The pay states the amount, how often and how it is paid.
A probation of at most six months; up to twelve only exceptionally and in the employee's interest.
Signed and dated by or on behalf of the employer.
Work outside the State for a month or more: the countries and period, the currency, the benefits and the repatriation, before departure.
Only the items s. 3(3) names may point to a law or agreement.
